issue.title: Refresh Bob Refs browse documentation images after NOW change
issue.description: After the Bob Refs NOW section and pill wording change lands and master CI is green, run just docs-media in bob-mac-capture, confirm both Refs browse images show NOW and the updated why-here wording, then commit the images together with docs/media.yml. Do not refresh before master CI is green.

task_type_fields.impact: The published Bob Refs docs would show headers and why-here copy that disagree with the shipped UI.
task_type_fields.repro: The current committed images are generated from the pre-change UI and show TODAY plus In Today · BLOG Pomodoro; after the section rename they will not match the rendered panel. Once the change lands and master CI is green, run just docs-media and inspect both images.

issue.creation_reason: The approved refs section change makes the committed browse screenshots show stale NOW headers and why-here text. This generated-image refresh is explicitly deferred until the change lands and master CI passes, so it needs separate follow-up tracking.

payload.description: Batch-18 planning: need candidate scope and actionability

PNG bytes matched the already-committed browse images; light and dark refs-browse both show NOW 1, Team Fit Review, and Now · BLOG Pomodoro. just docs-check passed with this bob-cli tree as BOB_CLI_DIR.
